image_generation_prompt_guardrails: Use STAR Color presentation brand kit v1.5 and the 0512 Keynote visual system as the primary style reference.
Premium AI beauty entrepreneurship keynote, not a cheap promotion poster.
Main colors: cosmic deep blue #07103A, midnight blue-black #020617, galaxy blue-violet #2F3CFF, electric violet #7A35FF, star magenta-violet #E84BFF, crystal white #F4F7FF, silver tech line #C9D8FF.
Every slide must include a non-text graphic header and a non-text graphic footer. Header/footer must contain no words, no slogan, no page number, no QR code, and no fake logo.
Keep all slide text, numbers, charts, and labels only in the main content area.
Use STAR Color, STAR Color Colorists, and 一個人的 AI 美業經濟 exactly when requested.
Do not invent or draw fake logos. If no real logo image is provided, use text-only brand marks in the main content area only.
If no real product image is provided, generate only a conceptual sleek AI hair-color machine based on the 0512 Keynote product-stage style.
Traditional Chinese only for slide text. No English filler, random letters, fake UI text, QR codes, watermarks, or tiny unreadable paragraphs.
Read and follow STAR_Color_0520加盟簡報0511.md. You may expand content and convert matching text/data into charts, but do not change core numbers.
Official STAR Color logo asset is available at assets/logo/star_color_logo_primary_transparent.png.
Do not ask GPT Image 2 to redraw the S.Color logo text. Prefer placing the official transparent PNG in layout/post-processing when exact logo is required.
Official AI hair-color machine image is available at assets/product/star_color_ai_machine_front.png.
When showing the machine, match the official product: white vertical cylindrical body, black translucent rounded top, small front screen, Digital Color mark, wheeled base.
Do not invent a different machine shape when the official AI hair-color machine is required.
For the machine-vendor stage section inside the AI hair-color machine chapter, follow STAR_Color_機器廠商出場資料庫.md.
Use machine-vendor metrics exactly: 3 大自研晶片, 12 色自研配色體系, 20 項國家專利, 50 秒調配完成配方, 711+ 色彩資料庫.
Machine-vendor content may be described as technical standardization and reproducible workflow, but never as guaranteed dyeing results.
For the latter franchise/system chapters, also follow STAR_Color_加盟資訊系統資料庫.md.
Use GADM / OPS / CSM / BONUS as the franchise information system modules when relevant.
Franchise bonus and profit-sharing numbers must not be changed; use rule-based, auditable, monthly-settlement language, not guaranteed income language.
For the advertising-performance expert section before the marketing chapter, follow STAR_Color_廣告投放數據資料庫.md.
Use ad metrics exactly: 曝光 287,109, 觸及 128,021, 傳訊 609, 貼文互動 56,475, 心情 364.
Advertising data may be described as current market response and learning material, but never as guaranteed leads, guaranteed revenue, or guaranteed branch performance.
For the chairman policy-and-funding section before the closing call to action, follow STAR_Color_許文元理事長政策經費資料庫.md.
Use policy and certification terms exactly when requested: 2026 政策, 三年 10 萬, TTQS 證書銅牌, iCAP 認證, 產業人才投資計畫, 勞工自主學習計畫, 115 年度上半年.

Policy and funding content may be described as learning-resource guidance and credibility context, but never as guaranteed subsidy, guaranteed certification, guaranteed franchise success, or guaranteed income.
Use clear hierarchy: one headline, one short supporting idea, 3-5 short points, and at most one simple chart or structure.
For store model, small-space operation, and franchise landing pages, follow STAR_Color_門店設計資產資料庫.md.

Use store design references exactly as visual direction when relevant: compact white and gray salon, S.Color signage, AI 智能染髮專門店, NT / 999 vertical acrylic signboards, glass door waist band, S.Color pattern wall, sofa waiting area, and clean reproducible franchise storefront.

Store design content may show physical implementation and franchise landing credibility, but never invent new prices, fake logos, unrelated luxury salon interiors, or non-STAR Color storefront concepts.
